component.name: Mote
component.summary: Connect to Linux desktops over RDP and VNC

description.p: Mote is a remote desktop client for GNOME specifically designed to connect to Linux desktops over RDP and VNC. Supported implementations include GNOME Remote Desktop (including Remote Login), xrdp, KRdp, TigerVNC and wayvnc.

ul.li: Designed and tested for full compatibility with GNOME Remote Desktop (and Remote Login), xrdp and KRdp
Dynamic resolution resizing for supported sessions including seamless HiDPI support
H.264 video encoding with RemoteFX fallback
Full clipboard sharing between host and remote machines
VNC with RSA-AES, VeNCrypt and TLS encryption, resizing and clipboard sharing
SSH tunnels and RD gateway support
Wake-on-LAN support with built-in fault tolerance
Sound, microphone and folder sharing with supported remote sessions
Import existing RDP and VNC files directly into the app or import from Remmina

screenshot.caption: A session beside the saved connections

description.p: A connection can have several addresses, tried in order until one connects. They reorder by dragging. An .rdp file's alternate full address is one of them.
Scan Network covers additional subnets, kept from one scan to the next. Flatpak bundles receive updates.
Scan Network lists the RDP servers on the local network. The connection editor has a Delete button. Deleting a connection ends its session.
Connections can open fullscreen or in a new window. Account avatars can be hidden.
Clipboard sharing is off by default. Copied files are shared only when allowed. The Flatpak shares its data with the other installs.
